description: Electricity transmission network of Pakistan (OpenStreetMap extract, 2017) is a data set listed in opendata.com.pk, an open data portal, published or maintained by Energydata.info (The World Bank). The transmission network map is obtained from the OpenStreetMap (OSM) database version 06.Feb.2017. The level of completeness varies across different areas due to poor satellite/aerial imagery and/or resolution in some areas, and due to a lack of OSM editors to help improve the data. Coverage: Pakistan. The portal files it under the publisher Energydata.info (The World Bank). Its tags are Transmission and distribution. It offers 1 resource(s) in URL. The portal shows 2021-04-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-pk-portal.
